user_problem: Large goals stall because users do not know the next concrete action or realistic sequence.
First-time builders need a practical sequence for market research, launch assets, and financial setup.
Users need one ranked plan that blends calendar pressure, tasks, document deadlines, and personal routines.
Learners need an adaptive sequence that responds to weak skills, daily availability, and motivation dips.
Users miss value across apps because tasks, habits, documents, spend, and learning reminders are fragmented.
Scanned PDFs, receipts, and forms often contain dates and obligations that never become tasks.
Repeated translations lose context when users move between travel, work, and learning situations.
Users churn after broken streaks because the app does not help them recover without shame or overload.
Users can identify plants but need a care plan that turns recognition into reminders and supply lists.
Creators can generate designs but struggle to convert campaign goals into an asset sequence.
Users forget subscription renewals, bill dates, and reimbursement tasks after scanning receipts or invoices.
Users need privacy-preserving reminders for expiring credentials and shared account hygiene.
